# Caution Nitro verification primitives

Unmodified MIT-licensed files from https://codeberg.org/caution/tee-attestation-js at commit `ba0d0c57de673c8576c91a8730775a87575f5c10`. Only Nitro and its CBOR/X.509 helpers are included. CipherScan policy and OpenSSL path validation live outside this directory. Updates must preserve the license and rerun the attestation tests.
